Imagine starting your day in a buzzing warehouse where no two days are ever the same. As a Warehouse Operative, you’ll become part of an enthusiastic and supportive team that keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes. From the moment products arrive until they’re on their way to customers, you’ll play a key role in making it all happen.

You’ll move between different departments. Sometimes you’re receiving goods in inbound, other times you’re carefully picking and packing orders that need to go out the door. Every task you handle contributes to a seamless process, ensuring customers get exactly what they need, right on time.

Along the way, you’ll also get hands-on experience with equipment like forklifts, reach trucks, and OPT systems. Never used them before? That’s no problem, comprehensive training is provided so you can quickly gain confidence and expand your skills.

Teamwork is at the heart of this role. You’ll collaborate closely with your colleagues, supporting each other to hit daily targets and celebrating successes together. Accuracy and attention to detail are key, because every order counts and every customer matters.

This is more than just a warehouse role. It’s a chance to grow, learn, and become part of a dynamic environment where your contribution truly makes a difference.

Proficiency in English or Dutch is required.

- Good salary depending on your experience
- Direct contract with the employer
- Supportive working environment: training provided so you can develop your skills
- Dynamic and varied role: no two days are the same
- Career opportunities: chance to grow further in warehousing and logistics

SamenvattingDo you want to work as an Orderpicker at a major logistics player in Nieuwegein, where you help supply Albert Heijn supermarkets every day? You’ll earn an attractive salary and work in a dynamic, international team. Choose this opportunity as an Orderpicker in Nieuwegein and experience genuine appreciation for your efforts. Good work!Over de functieAs an Orderpicker at this logistics organization in Nieuwegein, you make sure supermarkets receive their fresh products every day. Using a modern voice-picking system, available in Dutch, English, Polish, and Ukrainian, you collect orders in the warehouse. You walk a lot, pick products from shelves, and prepare orders for transport. You work quickly and accurately, because the stores depend on you. The job takes place in a refrigerated environment (around 4°C), so it’s important you are comfortable with cooler temperatures. You’ll receive clear instructions through the voice-picking system so you know exactly which products to collect.
- Collecting fresh products using a voice-picking system
- Checking the correct quantities and products per order
- Carefully stacking and preparing orders for shipping
- Working in a chilled warehouse (approx. 4°C)
- Cooperating with colleagues in an international team

You work full time on morning shifts from 05:00 to 14:30 or night shifts from 19:30 to 04:00, depending on the schedule.
Over het bedrijfAt this logistics distribution center in Nieuwegein, everything is about delivering fresh products to Albert Heijn supermarkets on time. The team is made up of colleagues from various nationalities who work together for a smooth and efficient operation. The workplace atmosphere is energetic, friendly, and there’s always room for a joke during breaks. You’ll work with modern systems and receive plenty of support as a new employee. Here, you get the chance to become a real part of a close-knit team that aims for the best results together.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Experience handling guest requests and service recovery

Your Benefits & Perks

• Discounted hotel stays across the Radisson Hotel Group world
